reference.verdict: Audit 2026-09-25: verdict **official_api** (confidence high). OLX Brasil integration portal documents ad import (insert/edit/delete), published ads, leads, chat, webhooks and vehicle history APIs for integrators/professional advertisers.

reason: Upload-only official API (https://developers.olx.com.br/): OLX Brasil integration portal documents ad import (insert/edit/delete), published ads, leads, chat, webhooks and vehicle history APIs for integrators/professional advertisers. It manages the account's own adverts (create/update/delete) and has no public listing search, VIN decode or valuation; the automotive vocabulary is read-only (no write verbs), so it is recorded, not served.
